author: musho7-dev
subject: Redesign room list and create room as full-screen pages
body:
- Room list: YOU card (car picture, name), big CREATE ROOM; open rooms as cards with
  map picture, distance badge, player dots and JOIN / RACING / FULL / NO MAP
- Create room: big map preview with name and description; map tiles with pictures,
  players and distance as big buttons
- Same layout and safe-area margins as the TUNE screen
